scorer_contract: Scores dilated-box overlap. boundary_iou uses ceil(0.2*box_size) margins; metric named iou uses ceil(0.5*box_size) margins and therefore is not undilated box IoU.
contract_ambiguity: Task description calls location box center, but pinned scorer treats location as minimum corner: lower=location-margin, upper=location+size-1+margin. Source TXT says Location (Voxels) without resolving semantics. Present source and scorer interpretations explicitly; do not silently choose one as clinical truth.
